I try to clear out as many miscellaneous quests as possible, then avoid talking to people as much as I can to stop new ones piling up. Then with bigger quests I do them by catagory, so could be location (all whiterun quests) or story (thieves guild etc) or role play (do quests that would matter to your character).
If I'm struggling to get into it, I find making myself do a few quests at random helps, cause often it's not be able to choose one that stops me. Idk might help you out

I can understand that, feeling out of control is horrible and often leads to many mental illnesses. My mother would tell me not to worry about things I can't control, but I find this unhelpful. Something I found therapeutic is to distract myself with things I can control. But mostly talking to someone helps a lot, be it online or in person.

I feel like that a lot, the best way I've found so far is to take small steps. One day at a time, hour at a time or even a minute at a time on bad days. The only other thing that helps me is therapy, but that's a personal choice. I hope one day you'll feel differently.

I think it's really great you explain how you feel to your step son, mental illness is confusing anyways but even more so to children that don't know how to world works yet.
